name: Mantle
long_description:
Mantle is a full-stack field service company that deploys, fixes and maintains machines for the companies that build them. We're not a marketplace or software tool, we own uptime directly to provide better, more reliable service without burdening your engineers on support calls. 

$500B+ a year is spent to keep machines running in the US, we're coming for all of it.

launches.title: Mantle Machines 🛠️ - The AI-native pit crew for machines and robots
launches.tagline: Mantle installs, repairs and maintains America’s industrial machinery
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We’re[ Kieran](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kieran-luke-white/) and[ Graham](https://www.linkedin.com/in/graham-smith-a69572130/) - co-founders of[ Mantle Machines](https://www.mantlemachines.com/).

**TL;DR**

**Mantle is building an AI-native maintenance provider for automated machinery - fast, reliable field service that actually keeps America's machines running.**

Whether it’s a CNC machine or robot, these things break a lot. Each industrial machine in the US is down for 30 hours every month, costing facilities millions of dollars in downtime. 

All existing solutions are terrible - maintenance is done in the same slow, inefficient way today as it was in the 1600s, yet machinery is increasingly advanced.

Meet Mantle, the modern maintenance provider.

<https://youtu.be/HUym8n8l7oE>

**Ask:** Do you build or operate industrial machines and robots? Or know someone who does? We’d love to chat - [kieran@mantlemachines.com](mailto:kieran@mantlemachines.com)

**Problem ❌**

Building machines and robots isn’t the bottleneck anymore. Keeping them running is.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=128414&key=user_uploads/1159251/0cece715-da43-4789-bafe-09766adb75ff)

There are around 100 million commercial machines in the US, and they get more advanced every year. But maintenance still works the same way it did in the 1600s:

* 1 in 4 repair visits fail.
* 1 in 3 technicians are late.
* Each costs 3x what it should.

And when a machine breaks, you only have three options (all of them are terrible):

1. Fly your own engineers out, fix the machine slowly and spend $5k+ on travel every trip.
2. Hire technicians in every city and pay them to sit idle 60% of the time.
3. Call a random repair company that has never seen your machines before.

All while America is facing an insurmountable labour shortage. The country needs 1.7 million new skilled tradespeople every year, yet barely half are actually trained, and five retire for every two who start.

We need another way.

**Solution ✅**

Mantle is an AI-native maintenance provider that owns uptime directly. We install automated machinery, repair it when it breaks, and preventatively maintain it so it breaks less and less.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=128414&key=user_uploads/1159251/90e93227-5976-4ec9-a794-a8775de02057)

Here’s how we do it:

1. **We learn every individual machine -** Ingest manuals, create a repair history, connect to its telemetry or set it up ourselves to create a digital twin of each unit, all before our first visit.
2. **AI finds the fault and runs ops -** Our agents diagnose the problem, fix what they can remotely, and send the right technician with the right part from our warehouse.
3. **Our technician already knows each machine -** They’re local, trained on each model, and guided step by step with augmented smart glasses and an expert watching live.
4. **Every visit makes the next one faster -** Each job is recorded, we update the digital twin and capture tribal knowledge so what one technician learns, all of them know. The customer also gets real feedback from the field to improve their design and manufacturing.

All for one flat monthly fee per machine.

Because the know-how lives in our system, not in one person’s head, we don’t need a 30-year veteran on every job. In the future, we’ll have the data to train robots to do the fixing too.

**Why it Works for Customers 📈**

* **Reliable -** An expert on each specific machine arrives with the correct part, every time.
* **Presentable -** Every technician is professional and great with customers.
* **Time -** Technicians arrive fast.
* **Cost -** One fixed and predictable fee.

**🙏 Our Ask**

We’re live today with multiple customers and 250+ technicians in the field.

If you manufacture, own or operate industrial machinery or robotics, let’s talk:

📩 [kieran@mantlemachines.com](mailto:kieran@mantlemachines.com)

🖥️[ mantlemachines.com](http://mantlemachines.com)

**👬 The team**

We’re both second-time founders and have spent our careers deploying and maintaining machines and robots.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=128414&key=user_uploads/1159251/4507a26b-7997-4405-a989-529f0b2423ae)

Kieran’s last YC company, Curo (F24), built the world's largest private EV charging network for Uber, Zoox and Google before acquisition by Inspiration Mobility Group ($415M raised). Before Curo he was the youngest employee at Tesla and set up the European service network for Model 3.

Graham previously founded Babylon, the world’s largest fleet of autonomous vertical farms. Babylon raised $22M and deployed 400 farms with Compass, LinkedIn and American Airlines. Before Babylon, he scaled an electronics repair business he started at 14.
